notes.title: ComiPo! Ver.4.00.00 Update
notes.content:
We're happy to bring you another major update to ComiPo!
ComiPo! is now updated to Ver.4.00.00.

[h3]Major changes from Ver.  3.52.00 to 4.00.00[/h3]

[h3]Support for deforming the eyes of 3D characters[/h3]
"Edit Eyes" in the "Create / Edit Character" and "Change Face" dialogs can be turned on to change the [Size, Shape, Up-Down, Distance] of the eyes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/35c1779ab5abb216a6a1574b0dd6e93ef433e162.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/3c2d546da805e2f0f5628d663371f2c82409aa82.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/3247e2fd5b45991c96fa58be0148ec371077847c.png[/img]
You can also squint your eyes to increase the expression.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/d2a6e1e4a0ce78ceadcf54395cd3aa740a038e41.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/7b9460ef439caffca1063927abfc8b66cc204054.png[/img]
[list]
[*]  "Business Person" and "Maru-Maru Character" are not supported.
[*]  Some settings cannot be changed depending on the face type.
[*]  For characters with "Edit Eyes" turned on, hair shadows on the face will be reduced.
[*]  If [Shape=1] is set, the eyes will be a perfect circle.
[*]  If [Size=10, Shape=8, Up-Down=0, Distance=0], the eyes will be the same as the original.
[*]  Editing a character's eyes will not affect other previously created Comic Files and Snap Asset Files.
[/list]
[h3]Redesigned eye shape and position in Preset Character[/h3]
The eyes of the Preset Character have been adjusted to give the face a slightly different look.

You can disable this change by turning on "Revert the eye shape of Preset 3D Characters to the previous (before Ver. 3.52)" in "Asset" of "Preferences".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/096db3679ffd58621a46cad630f178e22fb5200e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/668092b2891bc29f5085efb676dbdcc41ab5d93d.png[/img]

[h3]Added 5 Balloon Tale types.[/h3]
"Thick Curve Left", "Thick Curve Right", "Flash Left", "Flash Right", and "Bubble" were added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/7e087233f98b15b68a918cd86ba20ea792759183.png[/img]

[h3]Add 3D Item "Goggle".[/h3]
"Goggle" was added to "04. Daily Items".
"Head Item" under "Change Item" allows you to attach it to your character and choose its color.

The best settings are as follows
        Female: Position Y=-95
        Male : Position Y=-102, Size=1.5

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/503f9782e1014208ecaa97b73fb6275298a4b91d.png[/img]

[h3]## Add "Copy Text" feature[/h3]
Copy Text" from the menu allows you to copy all text in the selected layer (or all on the page if there is no selection) to the clipboard.

You can also use the [Shift+X] key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/6e4eb4db0ba4275f16c98f4f477cb33363ac17e2.png[/img]

[h3]Support "High Definition 3D Rendering" on the edit screen[/h3]
"Render 3D layer in High Definition on the edit screen" in "3D Setting" under "Preference" can be turned ON to improve the quality of the 3D Layer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5736731/2f7c35ce5d133a1a18b6e0cad2a5fb5dbda63d66.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Turning this setting ON will increase the amount of memory used and CPU/GPU load. If you have problems such as "3D Layer is not displayed" or "Operation becomes too slow", please turn off this setting.
[*]This setting does not affect the contents of "Export Image File" or Comic File.
[/list]
[h3]Others[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camera angle (3D Rotation, 3D Zoom) is maintained in "Change Model" of 3D Item.
[*] Eye Brow can be lowered to -20 by "Change Face" of 3D Character.
[*] The number of pages can be edited up to 99.
 * Please note that editing operations and reading/writing speed of Comic File will be greatly reduced when the number of Layer and User Image is large.
[*] Use old model (before Ver.3.40) for 3D Character eyes" was added to "Asset" in "Preferences".
 * Turn ON if you want the same face as the old Comic File.
 * The contents of the Comic File will not be changed.
[/list]

notes.title: ComiPo! Ver.3.21.01 - update and final 32bit version
notes.content:
We're happy to bring you another major update to ComiPo!
ComiPo! is now update to V 3.21.01.

With the introduction of 64bit support, this is the final update for the 32bit version of ComiPo! as further updates will depends on the software being used in 64bit.

The 32bit version will stay available, but not benefit from further updates.

[h1]Update Content[/h1]
NEW: [b]64bit version[/b] optimization
[list]
[*]You can now create up to [b]64 pages at once[/b]
[*]You can now import up to [b]4000 custom user 3D data[/b]
[*]Program response should be slightly faster
[*]Error due to too little memory should not happen anymore
[/list]
*If your system support 64bit, the 64bit version of ComiPo! will automatically be launched. If it does not, the 32bit version will be launched instead.

NEW: [b]Rounded Panel[/b] added to Panel Shape

NEW: Additional 3D items
[list]
[*]「33.Vehicle_2」: 25 New 「Bicycle」and「Bike Helmet」
[*]「42.Bird_2」: 14 New「Rooster」 and 「Hen」
[/list]

UPDATE: Change Item function has been modified as follow
[list]
[*] The target has now been separated into 「Additional Parts for Body」 and 「Additional Parts for Head」
[*] 「Shoes」 Can be removed and color changes
[*] 「Bicycle」 have been added to Chair category
[*] Preset Item can now be used for all 「Head Item」
[*] Item Size can now be changed in increments of 0.5
[/list]

NEW: [b]Save Only Selected Pages As[/b] has been added to the File menu, letting you save the pages you select as a different comic file.

UPDATE: The cpd Comic file format has been extended
cpd files will now [b]include all the User images[/b], letting you transfer and open them on a different computer without having to manually transfer those images too.

NEW: New function [b]「Emphasize 3D Edge Outline」[/b]
「Emphasize 3D Edge Outline」 option has been added to「Export Image File」, 「Export Movie File」 and 「Print」which lets you make the #D Edge outline stronger.

NEW: Switch Vertical and Horizontal writing key
You can now change writing direction in a balloon layer or text layer by using the H (horizontal) and V (vertical) keys.

[h1]Details:[/h1]
[b]■ Added a "2D Transformation" function [/b]
Two new functions will be added in 2D Image Layer:
- Perspective Transformation 
Tilt diagonally in 3D.   This function generates a sense of depth. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5736731/d9ec0b2540c930cbb893598f48012eeef991d582.png[/img]

An image can be modified by moving 4 vertices.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5736731/07020e03ca3fedcdbaf7a0b334fc214dda06f895.png[/img]

The shape of a panel can now be changed to the following:
- Rectangle 
- Ellipse 
- Triangle 
- Sloped panel (You can also change the angle of the oblique side)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5736731/c9080754cba038214ed4bb0b0ab015cef58f628f.png[/img]

[b]■ Shape/Tail of a balloon[/b]
Two new shapes:
- Capsule 
- Rounded Rectangle 1 
New tail modifications:

notes.title: ComiPo! V2.70.01 Update: Customizable skin colors and more
notes.content:
[b]"Change Skin Color" functionality added[/b]

You can change characters’ skin color by performing Change Skin Color in the Layer Properties of a 3D Character or from the Contents Menu.
This function changes colors detected as skin tones, so unforeseen areas (clothes, hair, eyes, etc) may also be affected. “Adjust Changing Area” can refine the affected area somewhat but there is a limit.
You can set the default Skin Color in the Preference dialogue.

[b]"Export Movie File" functionality added[/b]

Easily create an animated GIF or AVI video file from a frame or page in your comic.

[b]"Comic Tweet" animated GIF support[/b]

Tweet an animated GIF of a frame from your comic.

[b]Clothing color variations added[/b]

Added 7 colors for girls and 3 for boys to Summer Uniform
Added 5 colors for girls and 5 for boys to Sportswear
Added 6 colors for girls to Swimwear
Added 6 kinds of shoes to Sportswear

[b]Background images added[/b]

Added 17 images to 11.Sky and Weather
Added one image to 12.Night Sky

These images were provided courtesy of Fuuka Kaminaga (Twitter @kaminagahuuka).

[b]Comic Marks added[/b]

Added 17 marks to 21.Arrow & Finger
Added 22 marks to 51.Icon

[b]Item Images added[/b]

Added one image to 03.Disappointment
Added 2 images to 11.Sky & Weather
Added 4 images to 15.Light & Shadow
Added 22 images to 95.Figure

[b]"Copy Transparent-image" functionality added[/b]

Copy Transparent-image allows you to copy and paste to and from other supported applications that support transparency. Supported applications include Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and GIMP.

[b]Effect Line Setting added[/b]

Using the “Effect Line Setting” option from an Effect Line’s properties allows you to change its appearance.
In addition, 11 “Effect Line Balloons” have been added to Preset Snap.

Various minor bugs corrected
